payload.title: SGLang Performance Optimization Notes: August 2025
payload.summary: A compilation of 29 performance optimization techniques applied to the SGLang inference framework during August 2025, covering kernel fusion, communication optimization, CUDA Graph improvements, and backend upgrades.

sections.heading: 1. AllReduce-Add-RMSNorm Fusion for GPT-OSS and DeepSeek-V3/R1
sections.gist: Applies the FlashInfer `trt-llm-allreduce-add-rmsnorm` kernel API to SGLang, achieving performance gains on GPT-OSS and DeepSeek-V3/R1 deployments.

sections.heading: 2. PDL Support for Quant and RoPE Kernels
sections.gist: Enables Programmatic Dependent Launch (PDL) for quantization and RoPE kernels.

sections.heading: 3. Optimizing CUTLASS Fused MoE Performance on H20
sections.gist: Configures specialized tuning parameters for the `fp8_blockwise_scaled_group_mm` kernel on H20: - MmaTileShape: 64x128x128 - ClusterShape: 1x2x1 - Uses `KernelPtrArrayTmaWarpSpecializedPingpongFP8BlockScaledAccum` schedule

sections.heading: 4. FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE DP Communication: FP4 Quantization + Allgatherv
sections.gist: Optimizes the communication bottleneck for FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE under data parallelism (DP) by performing FP4 quantization before allgather to reduce communication volume, and introduces Allgatherv and Reducescatterv collective operation…

sections.heading: 5. Fast Math Optimization for per_token_group_quant_8bit Kernel
sections.gist: Addresses performance discrepancy between CUDA versions by enabling Fast Math compilation for the `per_token_group_quant_8bit` kernel.

sections.heading: 6. FP4 MoE Quantization Kernel: Grid-Stride Layout + Dynamic Launch Configuration
sections.gist: Ported from vLLM, targeting FP4 quantization performance for MoE models on Blackwell GPUs.

sections.heading: 7. Reduce-Scatter Communication for DeepSeek-V3, Qwen, and Llama4 under DP Attention
sections.gist: Extends reduce-scatter communication optimization to more model architectures, replacing all-reduce with reduce-scatter after MoE/MLP layers when DP attention max padding is enabled.

sections.heading: 8. FlashAttention-3 Backend for GPT-OSS: Attention Sinks
sections.gist: Adds FA3 backend support for GPT-OSS models with attention sinks functionality.

sections.heading: 9. FP8 CUTLASS Kernel Tuning on Blackwell: Dynamic Configuration Dispatch
sections.gist: Ports vLLM's FP8 GEMM performance tuning for Blackwell (SM100), using dynamic kernel dispatch based on input matrix M dimension.

sections.heading: 10. FlashInfer TensorRT-LLM FP8 Blockscale GEMM Backend
sections.gist: Upgrades SGLang's FlashInfer CUTLASS backend to the TensorRT-LLM FP8 GEMM implementation, focusing on low-latency optimization.

sections.heading: 11. Custom Set KV Buffer Kernel Fusion
sections.gist: Develops a custom CUDA kernel fusing key and value cache storage operations, identified via nsys profiling as a bottleneck on H100.

sections.heading: 12. RoPE + Set KV Buffer Kernel Fusion
sections.gist: Fuses the KV cache write operation directly into the RoPE kernel, eliminating separate memory operations and kernel launch overhead.

sections.heading: 13. MoE Padding and Quantization Kernel Fusion for GPT-OSS
sections.gist: Fuses hidden state padding into the quantization kernel for GPT-OSS MoE layers, eliminating redundant memory operations.

sections.heading: 14. Non-Padded Token Count for MoE in DP Scenarios
sections.gist: Fixes inaccurate token counting in MoE computation under data parallelism.

sections.heading: 15. TRT-LLM MLA FP8 Support
sections.gist: Adds FlashInfer's TRT-LLM MLA FP8 KV Cache Backend support.

sections.heading: 16. MoE Routed Scaling Factor Kernel Fusion
sections.gist: Fuses routed scaling factor computation into `moe_fused_gate` and `select_experts` kernels, reducing standalone operation overhead.

sections.heading: 17. GPT-OSS Attention Sinks with TRT-LLM MHA Backend
sections.gist: Adds TRT-LLM multi-head attention (MHA) backend support for GPT-OSS with attention sinks mechanism.

sections.heading: 18. TBO Optimization: Two Chunk Overlap
sections.gist: Improves Two Batch Overlap (TBO) by introducing Two Chunk Overlap, which intelligently splits long sequences into two chunks for parallel execution, eliminating idle batches.

sections.heading: 19. DP Attention: LayerNorm Before AllGather
sections.gist: Moves LayerNorm before the allgather operation in data parallelism, performing normalization on 1/DP-count tokens to reduce computation.

sections.heading: 20. FP8 MoE Kernel Schedule Selection for H100/H200/H800
sections.gist: Resolves performance regression when migrating from H20 to H100/H200/H800 for `fp8_blockwise_scaled_grouped_mm`.

sections.heading: 21. FlashInfer MoE Blockscale FP8 Backend for TP MoE
sections.gist: Extends FlashInfer MoE blockscale FP8 backend to tensor parallel (TP) MoE configurations.

sections.heading: 22. TRT-LLM Generated MLA Decode Kernel Integration
sections.gist: Integrates TensorRT-LLM generated Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) decode kernels for DeepSeek series models, with SM100 architecture compatibility checks.

sections.heading: 23. Disabling Python GC During CUDA Graph Capture
sections.gist: Disables Python garbage collector during CUDA graph capture using `gc.freeze()` to avoid GC scanning long-lived objects.

sections.heading: 24. MRoPE torch.compile Optimization
sections.gist: Adds `torch.compile(dynamic=True)` to `MRotaryEmbedding.forward()`, reducing kernel launch overhead for small VLM models.

sections.heading: 25. GC Freeze for Latency Jitter Reduction
sections.gist: Adds GC freeze functionality via `freeze_gc` API to exclude server warmup objects from garbage collection, avoiding 100ms-300ms pauses from gen2 GC.

sections.heading: 26. FlashInfer GPU-CPU Synchronization Optimization
sections.gist: Fixes unnecessary GPU-CPU synchronization in FlashInfer when page_size=1 by directly constructing a `torch.ones` tensor instead of GPU-to-CPU data transfer.

sections.heading: 27. FlashInfer GQA Tensor Core Decode Threshold
sections.gist: Lowers the GQA group size threshold for enabling Tensor Core decode in FlashInfer from >4 to >=4, allowing models like Llama3-8B with 4 GQA groups to benefit from Tensor Core acceleration.

sections.heading: 28. CUTLASS 4.2 Upgrade with K-Major Scale Factor Support
sections.gist: Upgrades CUTLASS to 4.2, enabling K-Major Scale Factor for SM90 FP8 Blockwise Group GEMM.

sections.heading: 29. FlashInfer/FlashMLA Chunked Prefill Cache Support
sections.gist: Adds MHA Chunked Prefill cache support for FlashInfer and FlashMLA backends, removing the page_size=1 limitation to support larger page sizes for improved memory efficiency.
